brief: Eric Peters' weekend note (One River). FOMC Oct 27-28 minutes, released Wednesday, showed almost all participants judged further rate hikes likely needed to return inflation to 2%. Fed's Waller pushed for a 50bp December hike, saying aggressive action may be needed to shock the economy. Goolsbee cited several months of high inflation with little progress. Cook said inflation has been above target for over five and a half years and warned delay risks needing larger hikes later. Investor Sparks argued AI is an uncontainable existential risk because recursive self-improvement would make it impossible to understand or stop, predicts 1-3 years of AI-driven disruption, and separately called US stocks 40-50% overvalued, with earnings 30% above their 50-year trend, saying the market should already be down that much before any AI-driven crisis plays out. He recommends 3-5yr Treasuries. Week-in-review: Nvidia fell 13.8% Friday on an SEC accounting probe after a Tuesday earnings pop reversed into a 23% weekly loss. Anthropic priced its IPO above range and jumped 17% before sliding 8.5% Friday on AI-unwind fears. The S&P fell 8.6% on the week, the Nasdaq Composite erased its 2026 gains, and the VIX touched 40.
